title: design_compose input
description: Generate a UiSchema from an object definition and/or an intent sentence (matched against fixed keyword and phrase tables) using layout templates and component selection. Provide at least one of 'intent' or 'object'. context=workflow assembles a routed, stateful application from the object's list/detail/form/timeline compositions. Every successful composition is recorded as a durable version beside the saved-schema store (compositions/<compositionId>/versions/<n>.json); pass compositionId to record the result as that composition's next version.

intent.description: A short intent sentence (e.g., 'dashboard with metrics and sidebar', 'user registration form'), matched against fixed keyword and phrase tables, not understood; a sentence with no layout keyword becomes a low-confidence dashboard (OODS-V116). Naming an object and a context is the reliable input.

object.description: Object name from the OODS registry (e.g., 'Subscription', 'User'). When provided, composition uses trait-driven component placement via view_extensions.

context.description: View context for object-aware composition. Determines which view_extensions are applied. When object is provided without layout, context infers the layout (detail→detail, list→list, form→form). workflow assembles list/detail/form/timeline screens with trait actions, routes, four UI states and generated application data.

layout.description: Layout template to use. 'landing' is a content/marketing page (hero + sections + CTA), not bound to a data object. 'auto' infers the best template from intent keywords.

brand.description: Brand scope for data-bound charts; defaults to A.

metricColumns.description: Number of metric columns for dashboard layout.

fieldGroups.description: Number of field groups for form layout.

tabCount.description: Number of tabs for detail layout.

tabLabels.description: Custom tab labels for detail layout.

regionOrder.description: The screen's regions (its direct children) by id in the desired order; regions not listed keep their relative order after the listed ones. Applied after composition; the composer never edits a schema by hand.

fieldOrder.description: Region id → field names in the desired order among sibling field nodes of that region (a field editor, a read-only row, or a slot placing a field component); fields not listed keep their relative order after the listed ones.

seed.description: Sample-data seed. Rotates the deterministic sample records (labels, names and derived values) generated for previews and workflow apps; recorded on the schema as `seed` and nothing else in the schema changes.

validate.description: Auto-validate the generated schema via the `repl` tool's `validate` action.

topN.description: Number of component candidates to return per slot.

transient.description: Do not record a composition version; the result then carries no compositionId. For scratch compositions only.

operation.description: With compositionId: the lineage operation recorded on the new version; default recompose. Design_preview action edit sets it.

compositionId.description: Record this composition as the next version of an existing composition (operation "recompose") instead of creating a new one.

parentVersion.description: With compositionId: the version the new one derives from; default the latest.

presentation.description: Named Stage1 inspection presentation: omit the accessibility score and prominently show measurement limits. Source records remain unchanged.
